rows.title_full: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES, WITH THE HELP OF A COMMISSION ON REORGANIZATION, TO REORGANIZE THE DIFFERENT DEPARTMENTS, BUREAUS, OFFICES, AGENCIES, AND OTHER INSTRUMENTALITI ES OF THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH OF GOVERNMENT, INCLUDINGGOVERNMENT-OWNE D OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS AND FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS, STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLES 135 AND 137 OF THE LABOR CODE (P.D. NO. 442, AS AMENDED) SO AS TO EXPAND THE PROHIBITED ACTS OF DISCRIMINATION AGAINST WOMEN ON ACCOUNT OF SEX, AGE, ETHNIC, ORIGIN OR BELIEFS
rows.abstract: Expands the prohibited acts of discrimination against women with respect to terms and conditions of employment so as to include favoring a male employee over a female employee as regard to: (1) job ASSIGNMENT; (2) HIRING, when the particular job canequally be handled by a women; and (3) DISMISSAL, RETRENCHMENT policy of the employer. Declares it unlawful  for any employer to deny any woman the benefits of employment or other statutory benefits by reason of her sex, age, ethnic origin or beliefs or relations.
